751320102.text: Please, heed my words. I am the guiding night-raven, both a memory of our Lord of the Night's poetic musings... and merely one of a billion notions amidst the moonlight.

751320103.text: Incline your ear unto me, for the spirit river beneath the earth has been shattered, and I can only speak to you via this image, to urge you — beware the pitch-black foe.

751320104.text: That broken mirror once beamed forth reflections bright. But now, dark smoke has gradually spread into three areas. Remember them well:

751320105.text: First, the east, where shadows have emerged from where they once hid, within the murals of legendary heroes.

751320106.text: The west is second, where, upon a sea of mystery, darkness manifests, affecting a galling parody of the lord of deepest night.

751320107.text: Third lies beneath the cliffs, where a pale fog that should have dissipated now spreads as Cinder City stirs...

751320108.text: O outlander hero, be wary... Tread lightly where our pitch-black enemy roams. Beware the all-corroding foe.

751320501.text: Tread lightly where our pitch-black enemy roams. Beware the all-corroding foe.

751320502.text: Is there anything you wish to know, O outlander hero?

751320504.text: Find them in the east, within a cavern where glowing trees sway and flutter. There, just as storytellers holding their woven scrolls say, lies also a terror hidden in stories from the past.

751320505.text: Perhaps that shadow seeks to escape its imprisonment through those very stories...

751320507.text: To the west, an island lies obscured by fog. Once, it was a sacred ritual sanctuary, populated by those who made a pact with the Iktomisaurs long ago.

751320508.text: But oozing filth emerged therein, and the holy site became a dark cesspit, sealed away and forgotten... Ah, but our cunning foe would never give up quite so easily...

751320510.text: That defiled fog was first created when the ancient city, Ochkanatlan, was destroyed. It should have been sealed away... But time and memory are against us...

751320511.text: If only... Alas... If only someone could dispel the pale fog once more...

751320513.text: Ah... Remember, remember... Be wary, be vigilant...

751320601.text: I can sense it, O outlander hero... I can sense all that you have done.

751320602.text: A mighty feat indeed, O hero. The corroded power is now returned to the realm of Night, and I can hear the Nightsouls rejoice.

751320603.text: ...Take these as your recompense, hero, for those who achieve greatness should not lack reward.
